judge.rationale: Strong agreement: all four primary Node 14 hypotheses comparably connect PTMA, HNRNPA2B1, TUBB4B, RPLP0, and Ki-67 through chromatin/proliferation, RNA processing, translation, and mitotic machinery, while mainly C and D add MYC-driven regulation and C further adds E2F and mitotic-chromatin details, leaving roughly three-quarters or more of the molecular explanation shared without an applicable ceiling.
